name: Werne (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 8:7:8, charged at the centre with the city arms of Werne (Saint Christopher with a small shield).
history: The hoisted flag is divided yellow, red and yellow in the ratio 8:7:8 with the city arms at the centre; the banner is parted in the same ratio with the arms in the upper third; the arms show Saint Christopher holding a young oak trunk.

features.role: Werne arms — Saint Christopher with a shield
